title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on People's Courts Further Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Further Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards by People's Courts for the Belt and Road Initiative

Fa Fa [2019] No. 29

For the purpose of implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully exercising the functions of the judiciary, and striving to create a more stable, fair, transparent, and predictable international, rule-of-law-based, and convenient business environment for the high-quality joint construction of the Belt and Road, the following guiding opinions are hereby put forward on the basis of the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative (Fa Fa [2015] No. 9).

I. Comprehensively Understand the New Requirements and New Tasks for Serving the Belt and Road Initiative

1. Accurately Recognize the Fundamental Task of People's Courts in Further Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative. At present, the international consensus on high-quality joint construction of the Belt and Road continues to expand, the coverage area is constantly broadening, the connectivity of the "six corridors, six routes, multiple countries, and multiple ports" is deepening, and transnational economic corridors and economic and trade cooperation are increasingly deepening. The legal fields are broader, legal relationships are more complex, and legal systems are more diverse. Promoting the formation of a broader, rules-based, stable, fair, transparent, and predictable international, rule-of-law-based, and convenient business environment is a common concern of all parties in the high-quality joint construction of the Belt and Road and is the fundamental task of people's courts in the new era to provide comprehensive services and safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative.

2. Always Firmly Adhere to the Guiding Ideology of People's Courts in Further Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative. People's courts must always adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly study and implement the spirits of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, and the important speech of General Secretary Xi Jinping at the Second Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds," continuously improve judicial capabilities, and firmly safeguard economic globalization and trade liberalization with fair and efficient judicial services and safeguards.

3. Correctly Grasp the Work Principles of People's Courts in Further Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative. Adhere to serving the overall situation, enhance consciousness and initiative, and provide targeted and effective legal safeguards for reform and opening up. Adhere to demand orientation, improve litigation procedures, strengthen the construction of litigation service centers, vigorously support the development of international arbitration and mediation, improve the new-type international commercial dispute resolution mechanism, and continuously meet the dispute resolution needs of entities jointly constructing the Belt and Road. Adhere to promoting the rule of law, strengthen procedural justice, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties in accordance with the law, accurately apply international rules, actively participate in the formulation of international rules, and strive to be participants and leaders in improving the rule of law rules related to the Belt and Road. Adhere to reform and innovation, deepen judicial reform, deepen transparent justice, deepen the construction of smart courts, and further build a fair, efficient, convenient, and low-cost dispute resolution mechanism. Adhere to the principle of green development, conserve resources, protect the ecological environment, actively integrate China's environmental resource adjudication into the global environmental governance process, and safeguard environmental interests and environmental security. Adhere to extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, strengthen judicial exchanges with countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative, reinforce international judicial cooperation, coordinate international judicial conflicts, give play to the role of think tanks, and strive to form a joint legal force for the joint construction of the Belt and Road.

II. Further Play the Role of Trial Functions to Comprehensively Serve and Safeguard High-Quality Joint Construction of the Belt and Road

4. Strengthen Criminal Judicial Cooperation, Combat Corruption with Zero Tolerance, Jointly Promote the Implementation of the Beijing Initiative for Clean Silk Road, Promote Transparency and Compliance, and Jointly Build a Clean Silk Road. Establish joint judicial counter-terrorism mechanisms with countries and regions along the Belt and Road, curb the spread of terrorism, and jointly create a safe and stable environment for the construction of the Belt and Road.

5. Fully Protect the Personal and Property Rights of Chinese and Foreign Parties, Comprehensively Apply Principles such as Territoriality, Nationality, and Protective Jurisdiction, Exercise Judicial Jurisdiction in Accordance with the Law, Timely Stop and Remedy Foreign-Related Infringements, Punish Criminal Acts that Damage Personal and Property Rights in Accordance with the Law, Properly Adjudicate Foreign-Related Administrative Cases in Accordance with the Law, Protect the Legitimate Interests of the Parties, and Enhance the Sense of Security of Entities Jointly Constructing the Belt and Road.

6. Firmly Support Multilateralism. In International Trade and Border Trade Disputes, in accordance with the spirit of the Initiative on Promoting Unimpeded Trade Cooperation along the Belt and Road, for foreign-related civil and commercial cases involving countries that have signed free trade agreements and cooperation documents with China, apply relevant rules to determine the validity and liability of contracts in accordance with the law, support the free flow of goods, capital, technology, and personnel, and vigorously promote the development of economic globalization in a more open, inclusive, balanced, and win-win direction.

7. Promote the Development of International Logistics in Accordance with the Law. Explore the specialized adjudication mechanisms for cases involving international maritime transport, China-Europe Railway Express, New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor, and international road transport. Correctly apply the governing law and international conventions. Promote the improvement of international logistics rules such as international multimodal transport of goods and transnational railway documents, and strive to safeguard the connectivity of the "six corridors, six routes, multiple countries, and multiple ports" led by economic corridors such as the New Eurasian Land Bridge.

8. Serve the Opening of the Financial Sector in Accordance with the Law. Give full play to the demonstration role of financial courts, encourage courts with conditions to establish specialized trial teams, further standardize and unify the application of foreign-related financial laws, closely monitor and study legal issues related to special loans for the Belt and Road construction, the Silk Road Fund, various special investment funds, Silk Road-themed bonds, multilateral financing development cooperation, and export credit insurance, efficiently adjudicate relevant cases with reference to international experience, and support multilateral and national financial institutions in participating in the joint construction of the Belt and Road investment and financing.

9. Support the Development of Information Technology in Accordance with the Law. Pay attention to the development trends of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, timely improve judicial policies in areas such as e-commerce, blockchain, artificial intelligence, and 5G information network construction, encourage innovation in new technologies, new business forms, and new models brought about by digitization, networking, and intelligence in accordance with the law, enhance network connectivity, and promote the construction of a Digital Silk Road.

10. Serve and Safeguard Innovation-Driven Development. Give full play to the window role of the Intellectual Property Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court and local intellectual property courts (tribunals). Implement the spirit of the High-Level Conference on Intellectual Property Cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative. Implement the Joint Initiative on Strengthening Cooperation in the Field of Intellectual Property among Countries along the Belt and Road. Efficiently adjudicate cases involving the Belt and Road science and technology innovation action plan, joint laboratories, science and technology park cooperation, technology transfer, and cooperative research. Severely crack down on malicious acts such as patent infringement, hoarding of trademarks, and free-riding and counterfeiting. Stop all kinds of unfair competition in accordance with the law. Create an intellectual property ecosystem that respects the value of knowledge and promotes innovation, and promote the construction of an Innovation Road of the Belt and Road.

11. Protect Green Development in Accordance with the Law. Implement the Green Investment Principles for the Belt and Road. Improve the systems of public interest litigation and ecological environmental damage compensation litigation. Stop environmental infringement. Implement the principle that the polluter pays. Promote the restoration of the ecological environment. Participate in the joint construction of the Belt and Road ecological protection big data platform. Promote green infrastructure construction, green investment, and green finance. Vigorously advance the construction of a Green Belt and Road and protect our common home on which we depend for survival.

III. Further Improve the Application of Law in Cases Involving the Belt and Road, and Consolidate the Rules-Based Law-Based Business Environment

12. Accurately Grasp the Legislative Spirit of the Foreign Investment Law. Accelerate the formulation of relevant judicial interpretations. Strictly apply pre-establishment national treatment and negative lists. Strictly determine the circumstances of contract invalidity. Maximize the maintenance of contract validity. Maintain the stability of economic order and business rules. Protect the legitimate interests of foreign investors. Promote comprehensive opening up.

13. Vigorously Promote the Spirit of Contract and the Principle of Good Faith. Strictly determine fraud and malicious collusion according to the evidentiary rule of beyond reasonable doubt. In foreign-related civil and commercial cases involving project construction, operation, procurement, bidding, etc., if the laws of the relevant countries have inconsistent provisions on the validity of contracts, apply the law that confirms the validity of the contract, so that the party who keeps the contract does not suffer losses and the dishonest party does not gain profits, and promote mutual trust and mutual benefit among the entities of the Belt and Road construction.

14. Improve the Mechanisms for Preventing and Responding to Environmental Risks in Cross-Border Trade and Investment. Strengthen research on the Model Law on Environmental Protection for Mining Investment in the Belt and Road. Jointly combat cross-border crimes against wild animals and plants. Cooperate in responding to global climate change and transnational environmental issues.

15. Fully Respect the Right of the Parties to Choose the Applicable Law in Accordance with the Law. When applying the principle of the closest connection to determine the governing law, it should be based on the identification of the claim basis, the determination of conflict rules and connecting points, fully explain the reasons for determining the governing law, and strengthen the reasoning for determining the governing law.

16. Utilize the Achievements of Smart Court Construction. Support research institutions, lawyer groups, industry associations, and chambers of commerce in conducting legal research and training on countries (regions) related to the joint construction of the Belt and Road. Jointly build a Belt and Road legal database and case database. Timely publish cases involving the application of foreign law. Enhance the transparency of rules. Guide the parties to understand and comply with the laws of relevant countries and reduce and prevent legal risks.

17. Integrate Resources such as Foreign Law Ascertainment Centers and Research Bases to Build a Unified Foreign Law Ascertainment Platform. Actively give play to the role of the International Commercial Expert Committee. Explore multiple channels to accurately ascertain and apply foreign law.

18. Actively Apply International Treaties that Are Effective for China. Respect international customs and international commercial rules. Promote the formation and improvement of regional and global commercial legal rules.

19. Strengthen International Judicial Cooperation. Coordinate the exercise of judicial jurisdiction. Clarify the legal status of international cooperation centers established in border areas. Explore the application of foreign law in domestic economic and trade cooperation zones and the application of Chinese law in overseas economic and trade cooperation zones. Take active measures to facilitate the recognition and enforcement of foreign civil and commercial judgments.

20. Expand the Influence of Chinese Law. Publish typical cases adjudicated by Chinese courts in multiple languages. Provide a basis for courts and arbitration institutions of various countries to correctly understand and apply Chinese law. Enhance the understanding and trust of international commercial entities in Chinese law.

IV. Further Improve the Working Mechanism of the International Commercial Court, and Continuously Enhance Its International Influence, Credibility, and Attractiveness

21. Adhere to the Principle of Fairness, Efficiency, Convenience, and Low Cost. Further advance the construction of the International Commercial Court. Based on China's actual conditions, draw on the experience of international commercial courts in various countries. Widely solicit opinions from participants in the Belt and Road construction. Optimize the case-handling procedures and working mechanisms of the International Commercial Court. Continuously enhance the international influence, credibility, and attractiveness of the International Commercial Court.

22. Give Full Play to the Demonstration and Leading Role of the International Commercial Court. Guide the construction of international commercial dispute adjudication bodies in areas with conditions such as the Shanghai Pilot Free Trade Zone and the Hainan Pilot Free Trade Zone. Improve the international commercial dispute resolution mechanism. Fully meet the judicial needs of international commercial entities.

23. Explore the Establishment of Mechanisms for Case Exchange and Sharing, Exchange on Application of Law, and Cooperative Training of Judges with Foreign International Commercial Courts. Enhance understanding and trust in each other's legal systems. Reduce legal conflicts. Continuously improve the ability to accurately apply international commercial rules and to use judicial adjudication to participate in the formulation of international commercial rules.

24. Adopt a Judicial Attitude of Presumed Reciprocity. Promote the mutual recognition and enforcement of judgments of international commercial courts on a point-to-point basis.

25. Strengthen Guidance on the Adjudication of International Commercial Cases. Establish a statistical reporting system. Make full use of the website of the International Commercial Court. Publish typical cases from time to time. Issue white papers when appropriate. Give full play to the role of cases in determining rules and guiding behavior.

26. Strengthen International Publicity and Exchange of the International Commercial Court. Encourage and attract parties to international commercial disputes to voluntarily choose the jurisdiction of the International Commercial Court. Serve the global resolution of international commercial disputes.

27. Fully Respect Party Autonomy. In international commercial cases, allow the parties to mutually agree to simplify or determine the litigation procedures. Encourage the parties to jointly submit foreign law. Further enhance the autonomy of judicial resolution of international commercial disputes.

28. Expand the List of International Commercial Arbitration Institutions and International Commercial Mediation Institutions on the "One-Stop" Dispute Resolution Platform of the International Commercial Court. Appropriately introduce foreign international commercial arbitration institutions and international commercial mediation institutions. Enable more international commercial disputes to be efficiently resolved in China.

29. Implement the Principle of Mediation First in International Commercial Cases. If the parties agree, they may jointly choose the International Commercial Expert Committee, an international commercial mediation institution, or the International Commercial Court for mediation at any stage.

V. Further Strengthen the Construction of the "One-Stop" International Commercial Dispute Resolution Mechanism, and Provide High-Quality and Efficient Legal Services for Participants in the Belt and Road Construction

30. Encourage Border Areas, Key Node Cities, and Core Regions to Explore Regional Bilateral and Multilateral Dispute Resolution Cooperation Mechanisms in accordance with the Principle of Extensive Consultation, Joint Contribution, and Shared Benefits. Establish Joint Dispute Resolution Platforms in Border Trade Areas, Cooperation Centers, and Port Areas. Use Information Technology and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR). Optimize Service of Process Methods. Reform Dispute Mediation Procedures. Address Practical Difficulties such as Difficulty in Service of Process in Foreign-Related Cases, Long Duration, Slow Notarization and Authentication, and Lack of Understanding of Foreign Law. Efficiently and at Low Cost Resolve International Commercial Disputes.

31. Improve the Cross-Border Bankruptcy Coordination Mechanism. Explore the Application of the Systems of Main Bankruptcy Proceedings and Center of Main Interests. Protect the Rights and Interests of Creditors and Investors in Accordance with the Law.

32. Support Relevant Departments in Improving the International Investment Dispute Resolution Mechanism and Institutions. Respect the Dispute Resolution Clauses in Multilateral and Bilateral Investment Agreements. Fairly and Efficiently Resolve International Investment Disputes.

33. Strengthen the Construction of the International Commercial Expert Committee. Expand the Scope of Selection of Expert Committee Members. Increase the Number of Industry Representatives from Countries Participating in the Belt and Road Construction and Expert Committee Members from Developing Countries. Further Enhance the International Character, Representativeness, and Authority of the Expert Committee. Give Full Play to the Functions of the International Commercial Expert Committee. Encourage Local Courts with Conditions to Establish Mechanisms for Expert Committee Members to Participate in the Diversified Resolution of International Commercial Cases.

34. Further Support the Construction of the Regional Legal Services and Dispute Resolution Center of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Support Cooperation between Arbitration Institutions such as the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre and Mainland Arbitration Institutions. Appropriately Introduce Arbitration Institutions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region into the Construction of the "One-Stop" Dispute Resolution Platform of the International Commercial Court. Increase the Number of Expert Committee Members from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Continuously Give Play to the Important Role of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in the Joint Construction of the Belt and Road.

35. Support Domestic Arbitration Institutions in Establishing Joint Arbitration Mechanisms with Arbitration Institutions of Countries Participating in the Belt and Road Construction. Explore the Model of Enterprises Registered in Pilot Free Trade Zones mutually agreeing to arbitrate relevant disputes at a specific location within the mainland, in accordance with specific arbitration rules, and by specific persons. Support the Branch Offices of Foreign Arbitration Institutions Established in the Lingang New Area of Shanghai in Conducting Arbitration Business.

36. Actively Leverage the Power of Civil Organizations and Institutions such as the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, Industry Associations, and Chambers of Commerce. Support the Establishment of Joint Mediation Mechanisms for International Commercial Disputes. Promote the Simple and Peaceful Resolution of Disputes.

VI. Further Strengthen Organizational Mechanisms and Team Building, and Form a Joint Force to Serve and Safeguard the Belt and Road Construction

37. Improve and Perfect the Coordination and Guidance Mechanism. Strengthen Communication and Collaboration with Relevant Units and Departments. Coordinate and Coordinate the Specific Work of People's Courts in Serving and Safeguarding the Belt and Road Construction. Improve the Work Reporting System and Exchange Mechanism. Establish Unified Statistical Information. Timely Summarize Experiences that Can Be Promoted and Replicated. Timely Identify and Solve Practical Problems. Improve the Targeted and Long-Term Effectiveness of Service and Safeguard Work.

38. Build an Internationalized and Professional Team Training Mechanism that Meets the Requirements of the New Era. Establish Regular Exchange Mechanisms with International Commercial Courts and International Organizations of Other Countries. Formulate Joint Training and Teaching Plans with Universities. Cultivate and Reserve International Legal Talents.

39. Further Give Play to the Role of International Forums, Judicial Roundtables, the Belt and Road Judicial Research Center, the Environmental Resources Judicial Research Center, and Other International Exchange and Research Platforms. Actively Carry out Exchanges and Cooperation with the Judicial Circles of Various Countries. Support Projects such as Foreign Judges Coming to China for Training and Study. Invite Legal Service Institutions and Think Tanks from Countries Jointly Building the Belt and Road to Visit and Exchange. Promote the Formation of a Diverse and Interactive Pattern of Exchanges in the Legal Field. Gather the Wisdom and Strength of All Parties in Using Legal Rules to Jointly Build the Belt and Road. Provide Intellectual Support for the Innovation of a New International Rule System that Integrates and Promotes Each Other between the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st-Century Maritime Silk Road.

December 9, 2019
